baseline.name: CAP20_ONLY_NO_REENTRY
baseline.description: CAP20 rescue is final; no post-rescue re-entry.

research_candidates.name: REENTRY_PROTECT10_AFTER20
research_candidates.second_leg_proof: favorable intrabar excursion from re-entry >= 20 points
research_candidates.exit: after proof, first completed 1m close with directional move <= +10 points from re-entry

research_candidates.name: REENTRY_TRAIL20_AFTER20
research_candidates.second_leg_proof: running favorable intrabar excursion from re-entry >= 20 points
research_candidates.exit: after proof, first completed 1m close <= running second-leg MFE minus 20 points

frozen_rules: No change to exact +10m runner classifier.
No change to post-CAP20 re-entry trigger.

requirements: Candidate must beat CAP20-only on matched comparable re-entry events.
Result must not depend on session-end marking of unresolved trades.
Report total, mean, median, positive-rate and max drawdown on matched cases.
Report B and E separately when sample size allows.
No threshold tuning after forward OOS starts.
